name: tailscale
description: Manage a Tailscale tailnet through the Tailscale v2 admin API: devices, ACL policy, DNS, auth keys, users, invites, webhooks, posture and audit logs. Runs the open-source @yawlabs/tailscale-mcp server with a Tailscale API access token; Tailscale has no official admin-API MCP server. It is read-only unless you opt in: TAILSCALE_READONLY is saved as 1 when left blank, and saving it as 0 allows write tools. Optionally set TAILSCALE_TAILNET (defaults to the token's own tailnet).
